svg.aria-label: Vidhya AI: AI-powered educational assistant. FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL with pgvector, RAG, Telegram, subscriptions and PhonePe, Celery, Redis, MinIO, Docker, Ollama.
svg.text: AI-Powered Educational Assistant · Subscription & Billing · RAG Pipeline · Multi-Channel Access
FastAPI async REST backend with session & JWT auth
Subscriptions & PhonePe payments with billing engine
RAG pipeline: Mistral embeddings + pgvector similarity
Celery background ingestion + Redis caching & queues
Telegram bot + React web app on one knowledge base
MinIO object storage for PDFs and document chunks
TOTP 2FA admin, rate limiting & secure sessions
Docker Compose infra with Ollama local-LLM option
